description: Sign-in, MFA, PAM, and identity governance for all 45,000 workforce users and about 22,000 contractor identities
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Every division system federates to SYS-G1 except the hotel PMS and the 8 acquired theaters; no sign-in means no ticketing administration, box office, or SOC console
source_evidence: EV-075 (Group identity director interview); EV-006 (federation and break-glass); EV-042 (break-glass tests)
manual_workaround: Sealed break-glass accounts per critical system; box office stations keep cached sessions for the current event

business_process: Cloud landing zones and hub network
description: Network hubs, guardrails, keys, and logging in providers A and B
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: The TVOP (SYS-D3) production runs behind the provider A hub; an outage during an on-sale stops ticket sales for every tenant
source_evidence: EV-075 (Group cloud platform director interview); EV-018 (cloud inventory); EV-071 (failover test 2026-02-11)
manual_workaround: Fail over TVOP to the provider B disaster recovery region (tested twice in 2026)
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: TVOP, patron data platform, streaming, hotel cloud workloads

business_process: Wide-area network and venue and hotel connectivity
description: SD-WAN links from 30 integrated venues, 16 hotels, and 58 restaurants to the cloud hubs
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Box office, scanners, and POS need connectivity; doors open at fixed times
source_evidence: EV-075 (Group network director interview); EV-020 (SD-WAN and cellular failover)
manual_workaround: Cellular failover at every venue and hotel; scanners and P2PE devices run in offline mode for a limited time

description: 24x7 SOC, SIEM, EDR, and incident handling
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Card brand clocks (Visa 3 calendar days), client notice terms (24 or 72 hours), state breach clocks, and Form 8-K Item 1.05 keep running during an outage
source_evidence: EV-075 (Group SOC director interview); EV-011 (SOC coverage); EV-063 (client notice terms)
manual_workaround: Retainer firm tooling; EDR console access from provider B
dependent_third_parties: SIEM and EDR vendors; forensic retainer
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: All divisions depend on the SOC for detection and breach facts

description: Authorizes card payments for every tenant, stores card-on-file tokens (about 41 million), and routes to 3 acquirers and gateways
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: No payments means no ticket sales for 1,150 clients and the group; lost authorizations and refunds cannot be reconstructed
source_evidence: EV-078 (Director of Payments Engineering interview); EV-064 (41 million tokens; 3 acquirers and gateways); EV-003 (revenue)
manual_workaround: Queue orders as reservations for 30 minutes during an on-sale; box office P2PE devices authorize directly with the payment partner
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Live Venues tickets, hotel packages, streaming purchases, and all client sales

business_process: Online ticket sales and hosted checkout for all tenants
description: Event pages, seat maps, virtual queue, and hosted checkout for about 96 million tickets a year
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Client availability commitments (99.95% monthly in the 2024 client agreement); on-sale revenue is lost to resale markets within hours; seat inventory must not be oversold
source_evidence: EV-078 (General Manager Ticketing interview); EV-064 (96 million tickets a year); EV-063 (99.95% availability term)
manual_workaround: Pause on-sales and announce a new time; client box offices sell from offline allocations
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Live Venues and Hotels sell through it; SOC 2 Availability commitments to clients

business_process: Mobile ticket delivery and access control service
description: Rotating-barcode mobile tickets and the scan validation service used by group venues and clients
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Doors at group venues and client venues depend on scan validation; crowd pressure outside doors is a safety issue
source_evidence: EV-078 (General Manager Ticketing interview); EV-071 (offline scanning procedure)
manual_workaround: Scanners validate against manifests downloaded before doors (offline mode); printed manifests
dependent_systems: SYS-D3 access control service; SYS-D1 scanners
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Live Venues event entry (BP-LV01); client venues

description: Scan tickets and admit up to 20,000 people in the 60 to 90 minutes before doors at arenas and amphitheaters
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Crowd safety at the doors; a show cannot start more than about an hour late
source_evidence: EV-076 (VP Venue Operations interview); EV-043 (venue and attendee volumes); EV-048 (offline scanner tests)
manual_workaround: Offline scanner manifests; wristbands; printed manifests by order number
dependent_systems: SYS-D1 scanners; SYS-D3 access control service; venue Wi-Fi

business_process: Crowd safety, CCTV, and venue security systems
description: Radios, CCTV monitoring, staff door access, and emergency communications on event days
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Life safety; a venue does not open doors without radios and emergency communications; video older than 24 hours matters only for investigations
source_evidence: EV-076 (VP Venue Operations interview); EV-046 (CCTV recorders)
manual_workaround: Extra guards at unmonitored areas; radio-only coordination
dependent_systems: SYS-D1 CCTV and door access; venue networks
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: SYS-G3 WAN for central CCTV monitoring; SOC monitors CCTV recorders

business_process: Box office and on-site ticket sales
description: Box office windows and day-of-show sales using P2PE devices at 30 venues
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Walk-up sales and will-call on event days; box office also resolves entry problems
source_evidence: EV-076 (VP Ticketing and Box Office interview); EV-045 (P2PE devices at 30 venues)
manual_workaround: Will-call by printed list; card sales paused; cash where the venue accepts it
dependent_systems: SYS-D3 box office app; SYS-D1 stations; P2PE devices

description: About 47 million card transactions a year at 30 integrated venues on validated P2PE devices
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Most sales happen in the 2 hours around doors and intermission; about $10 million of food and beverage sales on a busy weekend
source_evidence: EV-076 (VP Food and Beverage interview); EV-004 (47 million transactions); EV-045 (P2PE devices)
manual_workaround: Offline acceptance within the limits of the P2PE solution's instruction manual; otherwise close stands

business_process: Front desk check-in, check-out, and room keys
description: Check-in, folios, key cards, and front desk card payments at 16 owned hotels and 6 managed hotels
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Guests cannot get into rooms; on venue event nights 9 hotels check in most guests within 3 hours
source_evidence: EV-077 (Director of Hotel Technology interview); EV-053 (16 owned and 6 managed hotels); EV-055 (PMS replication)
manual_workaround: Paper registration cards; pre-encoded emergency key cards; card imprint not used (call center takes payment later)
dependent_systems: SYS-D2 PMS; door lock servers; front desk terminals
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: PMS uses local accounts (not SYS-G1); WAN for door lock servers

description: Online booking, channel connections, and a 140-agent call center that keys card numbers into the PMS
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $16.7 million of division revenue per day; online travel agency connections queue for a few hours only
source_evidence: EV-077 (VP Revenue Management interview); EV-003 (division revenue); EV-057 (140-agent call center)
manual_workaround: Call center takes callback details without card data; booking engine shows a holding page
dependent_systems: SYS-D2 PMS and central reservations; booking engine
dependent_third_parties: PMS vendor; channel manager; booking engine vendor

business_process: Event setup, pricing, and on-sale management
description: Build events, price levels, holds, and on-sale settings for about 8,600 events a year; dynamic pricing at 27 venues
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: A missed on-sale moves demand to resale markets; artist agreements set on-sale dates and price caps
source_evidence: EV-076 (VP Ticketing and Box Office interview); EV-043 (about 8,600 events; pricing at 27 venues)
manual_workaround: Move the on-sale; fixed prices only (pricing module off)
dependent_systems: SYS-D3 event setup and pricing module

description: Pay-per-view and subscription streams for about 3.1 million subscribers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: A live stream cannot be replayed live; refunds for missed pay-per-view events
source_evidence: EV-078 (General Manager Streaming interview); EV-064 (3.1 million subscribers); EV-074 (streaming configuration)
manual_workaround: Offer on-demand replay and refunds
dependent_third_parties: Cloud provider B; CDN; video encoding vendor
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Uses SYS-D3 payment orchestration for purchases

description: Lighting, audio, video walls, and broadcast feeds for the streaming service
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: A show cannot run without production systems; streaming depends on the broadcast feed
source_evidence: EV-076 (VP Venue Operations interview); EV-046 (production segments; single encoder path)
manual_workaround: Touring productions bring their own consoles; local feed only

description: 58 restaurants and hotel bars on validated P2PE devices
process_owner: Division VP Food and Beverage (Hotels and Restaurants)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Dinner service; room charges post to the PMS
source_evidence: EV-077 (division VP Food and Beverage interview); EV-056 (restaurant P2PE devices)
manual_workaround: Offline P2PE acceptance within instruction manual limits; manual room-charge slips
dependent_systems: SYS-D2 restaurant POS and P2PE devices

description: The 8 theaters acquired in 2025 on the seller's ticketing system and a non-P2PE integrated POS until migration
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 1.1 million tickets a year; outside group monitoring and the group PCI scope document today
source_evidence: EV-076 (VP Ticketing and Box Office interview); EV-050 (acquired theaters integration file)
manual_workaround: Sell from TVOP for urgent shows (manual setup); cash and card at the box office through a standalone terminal
dependent_third_parties: Seller's ticketing vendor; legacy POS vendor
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Not yet on SYS-G1, SYS-G2, or the WAN (gap 2)

description: Hotel rooms bundled with event tickets, sold on the TVOP hotels tenant (about 180,000 packages a year)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Package demand peaks at on-sales; rooms are released to the PMS nightly
source_evidence: EV-077 (VP Revenue Management interview); EV-053 (180,000 packages a year)
manual_workaround: Sell rooms and tickets separately

business_process: Dynamic pricing and bot detection modules
description: Demand-based price changes (27 group venues, 310 clients) and session risk scoring for about 1,900 protected on-sales a year
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: On-sales can run on fixed prices; without bot detection, high-demand on-sales are postponed
source_evidence: EV-078 (VP Product, Pricing and Access interview); EV-072 (pricing and bot module configuration); EV-064 (1,900 protected on-sales)
manual_workaround: Fixed prices; postpone protected on-sales

description: Support desk for 1,150 clients and client notices under client agreements
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Client notice terms (24 hours for 186 clients; 72 hours standard); PCI DSS 12.10 response duties to clients
source_evidence: EV-078 (General Manager Ticketing interview); EV-063 (client notice terms)
manual_workaround: Email and phone from the out-of-band client contact list
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Group SOC facts drive client notices

business_process: Patron data platform marketing and analytics
description: Unified patron profiles, campaigns, and analytics for all divisions (SYS-G4)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Campaign calendars; model training for pricing and propensity; not needed to sell or admit
source_evidence: EV-075 (Group marketing data director interview); EV-037 (data feeds); EV-022 (daily immutable backups)
manual_workaround: Pause campaigns; divisions market from their own systems
dependent_third_parties: Cloud provider A; email service vendor
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Receives feeds from SYS-D2, SYS-D3, SYS-D4

description: Settle each show with artists and promoters; pay venue partners
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Settlement happens on the night or within days by contract
source_evidence: EV-076 (Live Venues chief financial officer interview); EV-052 (settlement procedure)
manual_workaround: Manual settlement from box office reports

description: Close, consolidation, and SEC filings including Form 8-K
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Filing deadlines; a Form 8-K Item 1.05 filing is due 4 business days after a materiality determination
source_evidence: EV-075 (Group chief financial officer interview); EV-027 (disclosure committee charter)
manual_workaround: Manual consolidation; outside filing agent
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Needs incident facts from the SOC and all divisions

description: Build, test, and deploy TVOP and streaming releases
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Security fixes and checkout script changes cannot ship
source_evidence: EV-078 (Chief Technology Officer interview); EV-070 (pipeline records)
manual_workaround: Freeze releases; emergency change path through break-glass

description: Guest internet and in-room entertainment at 16 hotels
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Guest complaints; not needed for stays
source_evidence: EV-077 (Director of Hotel Technology interview); EV-056 (vendor-managed guest network)
manual_workaround: Lobby access points; rate credits

description: Time capture, payroll, onboarding, and terminations
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Weekly payroll for part-time event and hotel staff; terminations drive access removal
source_evidence: EV-075 (Group HR director interview); EV-002 (HR roster)
manual_workaround: Repeat prior payroll
